title: General MobilityFromNRCommand MobilityFromNRCommand RRC connection re-establishment

entities.name: Mobility from NR procedure
entities.description: Procedure to move a UE in RRC_CONNECTED to a cell using other RAT such as E-UTRA or UTRA-FDD. Covers handover where radio resources are allocated in the target cell.

entities.name: MobilityFromNRCommand
entities.description: RRC message sent by the network to command UE mobility from NR to another RAT. Includes allocated radio resources for the target cell in case of handover.

entities.name: RRC connection re-establishment
entities.description: Procedure initiated by UE when mobility from NR fails, to re-establish RRC connection.

entities.name: RRC_CONNECTED
entities.description: RRC state where UE has an active RRC connection with the network.

entities.name: Handover condition
entities.description: Condition where MobilityFromNRCommand message includes radio resources allocated for the UE in the target cell.

relations.description: Mobility from NR procedure requires UE to be in RRC_CONNECTED state.
Mobility from NR procedure involves sending MobilityFromNRCommand message.
MobilityFromNRCommand message is guarded by handover condition when it includes allocated radio resources.
Mobility from NR procedure may lead to RRC connection re-establishment in case of failure.
